en.question: Claude calls a tool with a string where the schema requires an integer. What is the best handler behaviour?

options.text: Raise the exception so the malformed call terminates the agent run.
options.note: One malformed argument should not destroy an entire run.

options.text: Coerce the value to the expected type silently and continue processing.
options.note: Silent coercion hides bugs and produces subtly wrong results downstream.

options.text: Return nothing at all, leaving the model to decide how to proceed.
options.note: An empty response gives the model nothing to correct and invites a repeat.

options.text: Return an error tool_result naming the field and the expected type.

en.explanation: Validate at the boundary and return an actionable error. Naming the offending field and the expected type usually lets the model correct itself on the next iteration, which is self-healing for free.
